s1.syndrome_frame: A slowly growing vascular tumor on the scalp
salient_findings: 8-mm red, firm, mobile nodule on the left temporal scalp
Irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa on dermoscopic evaluation
Well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor with ectatic thin-walled vessels and intravascular branching papillary structures on histopathology
key_facts: The patient is a man in his 40s
The patient has no significant medical history
The tumor is located on the left temporal scalp
The tumor is 8-mm in size
The tumor is red, firm, and mobile
Dermoscopic evaluation showed irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa
Histopathology showed a well-circumscribed dermal vascular tumor
The tumor extends to the superficial subcutaneous tissue
The tumor is composed of ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
The structures are covered by swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
PAS staining showed positive hyaline globules in the cytoplasm of endothelial cells
Tumor vessels were positive for CD-31 and negative for D2-40 and HHV-8

shortlist.label: Dabska tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Matches dermoscopic and histopathological findings of a vascular tumor with intravascular papillary structures and hyaline globules

shortlist.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by the presence of hyaline globules within endothelial cells, consistent with histopathological findings

shortlist.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Features papillary structures and intracytoplasmic hyaline globules, similar to the case's histopathological description

shortlist.label: Retiform hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Presents with a retiform pattern and papillary structures, which may be consistent with the case's vascular tumor

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Can exhibit papillary structures and hyaline globules, although less typical, it remains a plausible diagnosis given the case's findings

raw.rationale: The presence of intracytoplasmic hyaline globules in endothelial cells, as shown by PAS staining, and the characteristic papillary structures with ectatic thin-walled vessels are distinctive features of Dabska tumor.

rejected.label: Glomeruloid hemangioma
rejected.why: Lack of glomeruloid structures in the histopathology description

rejected.label: Papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma
rejected.why: Tumor vessels were negative for D2-40, which is typically positive in papillary intralymphatic angioendothelioma

rejected.label: Retiform hemangioendotelioma
rejected.why: The tumor's architecture does not match the retiform pattern characteristic of this entity

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioma
rejected.why: The histopathological features do not align with the typical epithelioid morphology seen in epithelioid hemangioma
